summary: A three-story, U-shaped institutional or commercial building with an asymmetrical footprint due to an outward extension on one wing. The exterior features distinct horizontal banding using yellowish brick blocks, wood planks, and white blocks, topped with a flat brick roof dotted with glowstone.

shape.overall_form: U-shaped with one asymmetrical wing extension

materials.name: quartz_block
materials.role: horizontal banding, pillars, and roof border

rebuild_hints: Establish the U-shaped footprint first, ensuring one wing has the stepped outward extension as seen in the top-down views.
Construct the walls using repeating horizontal layers: walls of yellowish bricks with glass windows, separated by bands of wood planks and white blocks.
Add vertical white block pillars on the exterior walls to break up the horizontal lines.
Fill the flat roof with brick blocks, border it with white blocks, and place glowstone evenly along the edges.
